5737.title: Enrollment cancellation and address recovery
5737.rootCauseOneLine: A saved non-local address hides the in-dialog editor; cancelling enrollment does not reset this shared setting, but closing does cancel and reopening works immediately.
5737.proposedFix: Expose existing machine-access controls for address correction without implicitly clearing the shared server URL. Add a failing test for that precise correction interaction before changing production code.
5737.caveats: No timer/cancellation lock reproduced. Component checks use a synthetic SDK; existing server suites use real SQLite. Same agent repeated the checks in a second clean trusted checkout. No desktop restart, full network enrollment, or screenshot verification. No automatic PR because the claimed cancellation failure lacks a failing regression.
